scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); for (const name of fs.readdirSync('static/js').filter(name => name.endsWith('.js'))) cp.execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'static/js/'+name], {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/test_browser_save_runtime.cjs tests/test_candidate_bundle.cjs tests/test_import_picker_e2e.cjs tests/test_flood_fill_worker.cjs tests/test_resources.cjs tests/test_workspace_runtime.cjs
